text:
ava: Quick sync — trying to get the last set of models over the finish line for the catalog rollout tomorrow. Ozark7B and Fenris-lite are still flagged. Main blockers: licensing text clarity from Legal, perf profile for 2k context, and embeddings shape for downstream search. who can own what?

sam: I can own the perf profile for Ozark7B. Need the model bundle + ~500 sample queries and the token length dist. If anyone can drop the bundle link here I’ll start perf runs. ETA EOD. :white_check_mark:

jordan: FYI Legal flagged a clause in the Ozark license — copyright holder attribution and redistribution terms look nonstandard. I need the full license file and a link to the model weights source. Don’t paste large files here, just link.

ava: link: https://internal.artifacts/models/ozark7b/v1/manifest.json — includes weights_uri and license.txt (the license is the one Jordan mentioned).

priya: embeddings shape issue: the curation team sent vectors in float32 [N,1024] but our embedding pipeline expects [N,768] or a dynamic shape helm. That mismatch will break downstream similarity indexing. We can either: 1) reproject vectors -> 768 during ingestion (lossy), or 2) update indexer to support 1024 dims. Option 1 is faster but needs eval. Thoughts?

sam: reprojecting is doable short-term. I can add a small adapter that rescales/linear-projects to 768 and run quality evals. Will need gold queries and top-k checks.

derek: I can take rollout ownership (canary + rollback). Questions: do we have a fallback variant for Ozark7B (smaller quantized) to route to on failure? Also need a playbook entry for latency/regression thresholds.

ava: assign owners: @sam perf, @jordan legal signoff, @derek rollout. @priya please coordinate embedding decision with search team. If Legal can't clear the license today we should remove Ozark7B from tomorrow's list and push to next window.

jordan: reading license now. Short note: there is a redistribution clause with additional attribution required. Need confirmation from upstream author whether the clause is mandatory. I’ve pinged them; awaiting response. If they confirm, our legal-approved presentation copy will need the extra attribution displayed in the catalog UI (small text).

priya: noted. If we have to surface attribution we should add a small UI field — low lift. But embedding shape migration is higher risk. @sam can you draft the adapter as a PR and include a README snippet with the transformation math? I’ll run integration tests.

sam: PR created: https://git.redwood/infra/ingest/pull/456 — adapter + unit tests + brief perf harness. Running perf now against sample bundle.

ava: thanks. Sam, include a short benchmark: 95th p99 latency delta and token throughput. Derek, I’ll share the canary schedule once we confirm perf.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary ingestion pipeline for ozark-adapter -> 2026-03-18T18:40Z (manual approval required).

derek: once Sam posts perf numbers I’ll draft the canary gating thresholds (latency + quality). For rollback, we route 100% -> fenris-lite quantized variant if regression > threshold. Is fenris-lite validated as a fallback?

ava: fenris-lite validated yesterday by curation for semantic parity at 0.92 cosine vs ozark baseline — good to use as fallback. Add it to the rollout playbook.

jordan: quick legal followup: if upstream confirms extra attribution is mandatory, please provide the exact text to insert. I’ll sign off on the presentation copy after that.

priya: small ask for infra: add a migration flag so we can toggle reproject on/off per-tenant during canary. Saves us having to re-deploy. Sam, can you add a feature flag?

sam: yep I added a runtime flag `ENABLE_OZARK_EMB_REPROJECT` in the PR. Default OFF in staging, set ON for canary.

ava: recap + next steps: 1) Jordan: legal reply or we remove Ozark from tomorrow. 2) Sam: finish perf numbers + link to PR (in progress). 3) Priya: coordinate embedding integration tests with search team. 4) Derek: draft canary thresholds/playbook once perf posted. We’ll reconvene async here — if any blockers surface, ping the thread. :raised_hands:

sam: perf quick summary (running): p50 token gen 18ms, p95 72ms, p99 160ms on default 2k context (single-GPU). Latency within SLA for our dedicated tier; cpu-side tokenization adds ~6ms. Will post full numbers in ~30m.

jordan: upstream replied — attribution is required. They gave exact copy. Jordan: "Model trained by ExampleOrg. Please include credit and link: https://example.org/ozark-weights". I’ll attach signed note and generate approved UI blurb.

ava: great — Jordan please paste the exact blurb when ready. Priya — that means we also need a UI field in the catalog item for "attribution" (small text). Can you estimate dev time?

priya: that’s low lift — a single field + tests, ~1 dev day. I can slot it for tomorrow morning.

sam: full perf numbers posted in PR comments. No major regressions observed. I think we’re green from perf side.

derek: drafting playbook now. Will post gating thresholds and the rollback script snippet later today.

ava: thanks all. If Legal clears presentation copy and perf holds we’ll include Ozark7B in the initial catalog launch. If anything changes we’ll pivot to Fenris-lite fallback. Repeat: ping this thread for any blockers. :bolt:
